reason: A read-only data processing plugin that aggregates recent git commits, session activity, and daily memory entries into a Markdown weekly report and canonical JSON.

summaries.zh: 聚合近期 Git 提交、会话活动和每日记忆，生成 Markdown 周报及规范 JSON 数据。
summaries.en: Aggregates recent Git commits, session activity, and daily memory entries into a Markdown weekly report and canonical JSON data.

capabilities: Reads git commit metadata from a selected repository using limited read-only commands
Reads session and daily memory files from configured local directories
Aggregates and summarizes local data into canonical JSON and Markdown output
